title: VPN Connection Failed
content: If your VPN is not connecting, first ensure you have an active internet connection. Check if the Cisco AnyConnect or Pulse Secure client is running. If you get error 1205, your token has expired. Reset your MFA token via the IT portal. For access to the finance server, you MUST be connected to the VPN.

title: Finance Server Access Requirements
content: Access to the finance server (fin-prod-01) requires both active VPN connection and explicit Finance Department authorization in your AD profile. Standard engineering profiles do NOT have access by default.

title: Password Reset Policy
content: Users can reset their own passwords via the self-service portal at https://password.internal. If you are locked out, you must raise a ticket. Agents cannot reset passwords directly; they can only raise a ticket for the security team.

title: Outlook Email & Account Reset Procedure
content: To reset your Outlook or Office 365 email password, visit the self-service portal at https://password.internal. Click 'Forgot Password' and complete authentication using your registered Microsoft Authenticator app or SMS code. Once reset, restart Outlook.

title: Connecting to Corporate Guest Wi-Fi
content: To connect to the corporate guest Wi-Fi, select 'Corp-Guest' from your device's network list. A captive portal page will open automatically. Enter your email address and your internal sponsor's email address to receive a 24-hour guest access token.

title: Software License & Access Requests (Jira, Slack, Figma)
content: Requests for software licenses such as Jira, Slack Enterprise, Figma, or GitHub Copilot must be submitted via the IT Portal. Standard approvals take 24-48 hours and require manager sign-off.

title: Hardware Replacement & Equipment Policy
content: If your monitor, laptop, keyboard, or headset is damaged or malfunctioning, raise a hardware support ticket via the IT helpdesk. Hardware replacements require approval from your department head for expedited delivery.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Setup & Reset
content: If you changed your mobile phone or lost access to Microsoft Authenticator, navigate to https://mfa.internal/reset or open a high-priority IT ticket for an MFA bypass code.
